summary:
Main
Domestic futures and port prices weakened while seaborne quotations were relatively stable. DCE most-traded closed at 671.5 yuan/mt, down0.52%; the 61%, 58% and 65% port indices fell to 654, 608 and 813 yuan/wmt. The seaborne 61% index held at USD 89.20/dmt, the 65% eased to 106.75, and all 12 brand quotations were unchanged from the previous report.
